'''Alabar''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. [[Esselian New Order Party]] leader [[Jamson Freller]] held a press conference in the city urging incumbent president [[Cambira Ralle]] to step down due to his failing health.
